purpose: Determine whether the previously observed fixed-policy crossover survives using every request's complete lifecycle, before proceeding with adaptive controller evaluation.
prior_evidence: 54/54 fixed windows complete; two primary crossovers with 3/3 seeds, but both have only 1/3 matching reversals on the common-completed cohort. These are preliminary signals, not a closed motivation claim.

fixed.placement_m3_kv_network: Unchanged source experiment topology, layout, M3, policy edge sets, network intervention and full-lifetime executed-layer KV reservations.
fixed.trace: Same registered seed/load arrival trace; no further arrivals after the fixed horizon. Reproduce the historical 1800-second window before continuing it.
fixed.execution: Explicit conda activate gllm, PYTHONHASHSEED=0, one fresh interpreter per cell, independent cells may run concurrently on CPU.
fixed.drain: Continue the actual simulator state in 30-second chunks; deadline is arrival horizon + 1800 seconds. Incomplete drain is invalid; no requests may be dropped or imputed.

metrics.primary: P95 of per-request mean inter-decode-token latency over ALL arrived requests that fully complete during the bounded continuation. Every request must complete; output length one has no TPOT and is included in completion/TTFT/E2E.
metrics.prefix_sensitivity: Same full-lifecycle metric, restricted by predetermined arrival time, not by whether a policy completed the request before the horizon.
metrics.guardrails: Original fixed-window output throughput >=99% of the best policy; fixed-window completion fraction no more than 1 percentage point below the best.
metrics.other: Full-lifecycle P95 TTFT/E2E, complete cohort size, TPOT sample count, tail completion time, fixed-window backlog, KV capacity/reservation, decode batching, route counts.
metrics.offline_reference: Descriptive pooled full-lifecycle P95 for equal-duration cases under each fixed policy and state-wise lowest-mean-TPOT selection. Selection uses evaluation results and ignores switching/transient costs: optimistic diagnostic only, never online controller evidence.

decision.unique_winner: Overall lowest three-seed mean primary P95 TPOT, pass both guardrails, and >=1% lower mean P95 TPOT than the next eligible policy; if tied or a guardrail fails report no unique winner.
decision.adaptive_space_confirmed_in_tested_scope: Different unique primary winners across one registered pair; those same two policies reverse direction in >=2/3 paired seeds BOTH on the complete arrival cohort AND on the fixed arrival-prefix cohort; prefix means must also favor the respective primary winners.
decision.magnitude: Report both state-specific relative gaps and optimistic pooled static/oracle gaps. A confirmed crossover alone does not establish material dynamic net benefit.
decision.interpretation: Three seeds are descriptive; no statistical significance or dynamic-controller claim. If no pair passes, report adaptive space not confirmed in this tested scope, not universal impossibility.

integrity.freeze: Freeze protocol, follow-up runner/validator/tests and all simulator/rcaps/benchmark Python sources plus the original crossover source audit before smoke/development/formal runs.
integrity.independent_recompute: Persist per-query arrival/length, prompt finish, every decode completion time, query finish and route. Regenerate trace, reconstruct percentiles/completion/window output counts and KV/path checks.
integrity.historical_reproduction: Every formal window must reproduce its matching historical result for trace, core metrics, route counts and original per-request sample fields before tail continuation.
integrity.failure: Preserve failure JSON, logs and process exit code. No seed replacement, overwrite, silent retry or partial-matrix positive conclusion.
integrity.external_review: Unavailable; deterministic checks are not an independent cross-model verdict.
